title: Keep billing authority in product rules, not the model
narrative: A customer was charged twice. Fangore’s product rule is simple: only the billing team may own that ticket. The model may suggest a team, but it must not grant permission. He runs the judge over the ticket text, then product policy allows only when the route signal is billing. If the model picks technical support, policy denies. Builds on the idea that suggestions are not authority — see also `fangore_decision_surface_reject`. He uses this whenever business authority must stay in product rules, not prompt wording.
implementation: Kind `route_refund` (System One cassette twin: `systemone_cassette` path reuses the same runner). `judge()` + `JudgementPolicy` / `decide()` with thresholds on choice signal `route`. Soft expects: ALLOW when selected is billing; DENY when technical. Live/systemone twins share narrative.
